question: How high should the upper projection be when the elevation is divided into seven parts?
premises: The elevation is divided into seven parts
The upper projection is prescribed as half a part
The measure is applied thrice in that elevation
inference: The upper projection should measure half a part taken thrice within the seven-part elevation.
uncertainties: The exact sense of triḥ in this proportional context is slightly ambiguous
plain_english: When the elevation is divided into seven parts, the upper projection should be half a part, taken thrice in that elevation.
